bms_g_4168_20000602.name: bms_window_edge_state
bms_g_4168_20000602.description: Edge-detector state of bms_sample_window_process, one byte. 0 means the byte at the record's +3 offset was last seen low, 1 means it was last seen high. When the state is 0 and that byte is 1, the function increments the 16-bit counter at 0x200024D0 and sets the state to 1; when the state is 1 and the byte is 0, it sets the state back to 0. Only this function reads or writes the byte in this image.
